title: Chapter 1010
text:
As more and more Beyond Grade As arrived at the Black Star Corps headquarters, Han Xiao's territory became even livelier. In just a short while, an army of seventy to eighty Beyond Grade As had gathered there.

The Amethyst Civilization, which was in charge of this Star Cluster, gradually became nervous. They secretly deployed their troops and made some defensive arrangements.

Not only the Amethyst Civilization, but all the Star Cluster Civilizations in charge of the Shattered Star Ring, as well as the three Universal Civilizations stationed in this Star Field, began to secretly deploy their troops. Their fleets moved quietly, preparing for a rainy day.

With so many peak combatants in the universe, it was enough to easily overturn an entire Star Field. Furthermore, the ones who controlled this kind of power were independent individuals with free thoughts, so there was a risk of them not being controlled.

As for the Godora Civilization, which was directly in charge of the Black Star Corps headquarters, they gathered their fleets and hoarded them in the Star Zone where the Black Star Corps headquarters was located.

The undercurrents in the outside world did not affect the mood of the Beyond Grade As. With Heber being the last to arrive, the meeting was held as scheduled.

The location of the meeting was a large hall in the headquarters. The dome was a hundred meters high, and dozens of floating thrones formed a circle, quietly floating five meters above the ground.

The door opened, and the Beyond Grade As who had been staying in the headquarters for the past few days filed in. The tallest was Beast Ancestor, Gorután, and the shortest was the finger-sized Sun Hunter. Each had their own unique characteristics.

Everyone chose a seat and sat down. The allies of the three Universal Civilizations were clearly divided, each sitting in their own groups, with the Beyond Grade As of the other factions in the middle.

After sitting down, they realized that there were still three empty seats connected together. Seeing that Han Xiao had not arrived yet, they casually chatted and sized each other up.

While waiting, many Beyond Grade As had interacted with each other. In the past, some of them had only heard of each other's names but had never seen each other before. Using the opportunity brought by Han Xiao, these people got to know each other and made some new friends.

Among them, the ones who were visited the most were the peak Beyond Grade As with high statuses in the circle, such as Manison, Kasuyi, Kant, Gorután, and so on. Clottey and a few other Beyond Grade As did not come to the Shattered Star Ring, so they naturally did not participate in the meeting.

At this moment, the ones who received the most attention were the new Beyond Grade As who were born less than ten years ago, such as Hades of Radiance, Yin Ying of the Dynasty, and Tolaen of Ethereal.

After a while, three figures walked in. Everyone stopped chatting and looked at the door. It was Han Xiao, Hella, and Ames.

Han Xiao strode forward, arriving before the mechanical throne. He slowly rose into the air, turned around, and sat down, facing all the Beyond Grade As.

At the same time, Ames and Hella sat on the empty seats next to him.

Many people looked at Hella with curiosity in their eyes. There were many who were interested in this new Beyond Grade A Super from the Black Star Corps.

Rumble …

The door finally closed slowly.

With a smile on his face, Han Xiao looked around and slowly said, "Everyone is here. I'm sorry for the long wait. Thanks to everyone's kindness, everyone is willing to attend this meeting and support me …"

While speaking politely, he observed everyone.

As he spoke, some people sat upright and still with a solemn expression, some were expressionless and indifferent, some had smiles on their faces to express friendliness, and some leaned lazily against their chairs in an indifferent manner. From this, one could see the attitudes of some people.

There were more than seventy Beyond Grade As present, more than forty of them, including himself, were allies of the three Universal Civilizations. Most of the rest were alone, and a few were allies of the Supercluster Civilizations.

There were many people with multiple identities, such as the Ancient Ones and a few shareholders of the Limitless Financial Group. 'Beast Ancestor', 'Secret Master', and other protectors of the Galactic Black Market were also present. They were all important and worthy of attention.

There was a complicated network of relationships between these people. Some had good relationships with each other, some had grudges with each other, some were brothers on the surface but plotted against each other behind the scenes, and some were helping each other on the surface.

While waiting, Han Xiao also walked around and made friends with everyone. He also completed his probing and collected the combat information of everyone present. Only a small portion of them had higher levels than him, so he could not see the complete information. The abilities of the others were completely under his control, so he had a lot of information.

However, these people were still in the dark and did not know that their underwear had been seen through.

"No matter what reason you all have for coming to support me, I thank you all for coming …" This time, Han Xiao finished the pleasantries and went straight to the point. "I believe everyone has already talked to each other, so I'll save my breath and not introduce everyone."

Everyone smiled politely and stared at Han Xiao, waiting for him to continue.

Han Xiao lightly patted the armrest of his chair and said, "I'm holding this meeting mainly to discuss the problem of the Shattered Star Ring with everyone …"

Before he could finish his sentence, a discordant voice rang out.

"Humph, you can represent the entire Shattered Star Ring?"

Everyone's expression changed slightly, and they looked toward the source of the voice. The person who spoke was Sierron of the Radiant Federation and also a member of the Ancient Ones. He had a disapproving expression on his face.

Han Xiao's expression did not change. He smiled and said, "There are so many civilizations and organizations in the Shattered Star Ring. Of course, I can't represent the entire Star Field."

"Then what right do you have to talk about this problem?" Sierron questioned. "Don't forget, the Radiant Federation is the real ruler of the Shattered Star Ring. Only we can represent this Star Field, not you."

The other allies of the Radiance did not stop Sierron. They came because they were giving face, but as competitors, they would not let Han Xiao achieve his goal too easily. It was inevitable that they would make things difficult for him. Even if they did not stop him, they would not let him have it easy.

"I don't agree with that." Han Xiao slowly said, "I'm a local of the Shattered Star Ring and represent the dynasty to oversee this place. I'm also the strongest Beyond Grade A in this Star Field. Although I can't represent the entire Star Field, I still have the right to speak for it in my own name. Furthermore, I'm not announcing anything unilaterally. I'm just here to discuss with everyone."

"The strongest Beyond Grade A in the Shattered Star Ring? Not necessarily, right?" Sierron sneered.

Han Xiao raised his brows, opened his arms slightly, and said, "You're doubting my record?"

"Don't worry, Heber, Sisko, and Ames have all been defeated by you. I won't deny this fact. As for Hella … she's only a new student. She's most likely not your match."

Hearing this, Heber's expression turned ugly. He did not like outsiders mentioning his defeat in front of so many Beyond Grade As.

Sisko coldly glanced at Sierron before glaring at Han Xiao. As the saying went, 'don't point out someone's shortcomings when scolding them.'

Ames, on the other hand, did not seem to mind. She smiled faintly and was indifferent. Hella, on the other hand, was expressionless like a rock, turning a deaf ear to him.

"Then, what's your opinion?" Han Xiao asked.

"Very simple, there's still one person who has not been defeated by you in a head-on battle — Magus Austin!" Sierron shook his head. "He's just too low-key. He might not be your match. If you don't defeat him, you won't be able to maintain your position as the strongest in the Star Field."

Austin was stunned. Why am I being dragged into this all of a sudden?

Thinking about it, he understood. Sierron wanted to roast him on the fire, which was a form of provocation. Although Sierron most likely knew that he had a good relationship with Black Star, it would not cost him anything to try. As long as he could leave a mark on their relationship, it would be worth it.

"I admit that Black Star is the strongest in the Star Field, but I admit that I'm not his match." Austin curled his lips. This was the only thing he could say. He could not possibly spar with Han Xiao on the spot.

Hearing this, Han Xiao nodded at Austin before asking Sierron, "Any other opinions?"

"No." Seeing Manison give him a look, Sierron closed his eyes and did not say anything else.

Han Xiao glanced around. Seeing that no one else had any opinions, he said with a deep voice, "Alright then.

Since everyone acknowledges that I have the right to speak for the Shattered Star Ring, let's get back to the main topic … Since the opening of the Flickering World is imminent, I can understand that everyone has come to the Shattered Star Ring to wait for orders. However, I believe that everyone knows that with so many Beyond Grade As gathered in one Star Field, there will be many unstable factors. As the leader of the Shattered Star Ring, I have something to say, and I hope that everyone will listen carefully.

"Since I developed in the Shattered Star Ring, I naturally have the responsibility of maintaining the stability of the Star Field. I welcome everyone to the Shattered Star Ring as guests, but I have a small request … I hope that during your stay, you will not destroy the security of the Shattered Star Ring and cause trouble. If everyone is willing to give me this face, I will be very grateful."

This time, Han Xiao changed the topic, and his tone was slightly heavy.

"However … if anyone disregards my request, I will treat it as a challenge and will definitely not let it go. Remember, there's still a long way to go before the development of the Flickering World. I don't wish to have any conflicts with anyone."

Hearing this, the atmosphere suddenly became tense. Everyone had different expressions. Some were indifferent, some were approving, some were serious, and some were serious.

Although Han Xiao was very polite, it was essentially a threat and a warning. His meaning was very domineering. No matter where you came from, when you met me, the local tyrant, even if you are a dragon, you better behave yourself. Otherwise, you will not be able to bear the consequences!

If you want to cause trouble in the Shattered Star Ring, you have to consider the consequences of offending me!

Everyone present was the boss of their respective regions, and there was no lack of Star Field spokespersons. Many of them felt that these words were a little harsh.

However, with Black Star's current status and strength, he was able to suppress an entire Star Field. He was already qualified to say such words, and no one felt that it was inappropriate.

This time, Austin smiled and said, "I'm also a local Beyond Grade A of the Shattered Star Ring. I also do not wish for the Star Field to become chaotic. What Black Star said is also my opinion."

"Humph, me too," Heber said unwillingly.

Immediately after, Ames and Hella also expressed their opinions. Seeing this, Sisko could only pinch his nose and go along.

At this moment, the local Beyond Grade As of the Shattered Star Ring all supported Han Xiao, expressing that they would work together to maintain the stability of the Star Field. It was a form of acknowledging Han Xiao's leadership.

Han Xiao paused for a few seconds, taking in everyone's reactions. He suddenly smiled and said, "Of course, if you are willing to give me face, I am willing to cooperate with you in the development of the Flickering World. Currently, the Black Star Corps occupies the most territory in the Flickering World. I believe I can provide you with quite a bit of help."

The eyes of many sparkled.

Everyone knew that the Black Star Corps had a huge foundation in the Flickering World. Everyone's goal was the Flickering World. If they could obtain Han Xiao's help, it would naturally be more convenient. Before they came, they thought that Han Xiao was only threatening them this time. They did not expect him to be willing to cooperate with them. This was a small surprise for them.

"We will remember your words," Manison said calmly. "Radiance also does not wish to see anyone causing trouble here."

Seeing the Mecha Empire express their stance, the other Beyond Grade As also spoke.

"Since Black Star and the Mecha Empire have both said so, then no one is to cause trouble in the Shattered Star Ring."

"Wait patiently for the Flickering World to open. There will be plenty of time in the future."

"If anyone dares to mess around here, they will be our enemy."

"Black Star, we have given you face. Remember to fulfill your promise."

Hearing this, Han Xiao smiled. "I'm glad we have reached a consensus."

At this time, Manison suddenly changed the topic. "Black Star is worthy of respect for holding this meeting for the sake of the stability of the Star Field. However, I want to say that you did not gather us here just for such a small matter, right?"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He turned to look at him and stretched out his hand. "If you have anything to say, just say it."

"Alright, then I'll be direct."

Everyone looked at Manison curiously. They didn't know what he meant.

Manison pondered for a moment before slowly saying, "The advanced civilizations make use of us, and we make use of them. Friends here are working for different factions, so it's normal for us to fight and kill each other. However, I think that we should not be completely limited to the differences between factions. Those are the rules of the game set by the advanced civilizations. Sometimes, we should jump out of these rules and make plans for ourselves."

Hearing this, everyone's expression changed slightly, and they all fell silent.

This topic had always been very sensitive, and no one had expected Manison to openly mention it on this occasion. He did not hide it from the direct members of the advanced civilizations.

The moment they stepped into the Beyond Grade A realm, everyone was on the same level. Even if they belonged to different factions, it could not change the nature of their class.

Manison looked around and continued, "You all understand that the advanced civilizations need us, but they are also afraid of us. They do not wish for us to have too many personal relationships. It is very rare for us to have such a large-scale meeting like today. As you all have seen, we have only met once, and it has already caused a storm in the entire universe. There must be countless spaceships and cannons pointing in our direction now. You all understand that I am not exaggerating."

"We don't need you to emphasize our situation," Kant said with a frown. "I don't think now is the time to talk about this topic. It's too early."

"It's better to be prepared early than not," Manison said calmly.

"So, why did you bring this up? Do you want all of us to form an alliance?" Gorután said in a muffled voice.

"Let me remind you, forming an alliance is no different from rebelling," Kasuyi interrupted. There was one more thing he did not say. The pillars of the three Universal Civilizations like them were basically safe, so he did not want to care.

Everyone spoke one after another, expressing their opinions and arguing fiercely. Usually, there would not be many opportunities to talk about such things, so this event organized by Han Xiao became a platform for exchanging opinions.

"Don't worry, the time is not right yet. What I want is just a tacit understanding …" Manison looked at Han Xiao and said with a curious tone, "You are the organizer of this meeting. You listened for a while and did not stop us, so what is your opinion?"

Everyone turned to look at Han Xiao. Black Star's position in the circle was not low, so his opinion was also important.

Han Xiao spread his hands and shook his head.

"I have no other opinion. I just feel that there are still too few Beyond Grade As …"

"Yeah, too few." Manison sighed.

Han Xiao glanced at him.

When we said 'too few', we definitely did not mean the same thing.
